name: FileZilla
description: FileZilla’s updater uses an embedded root certificate for update metadata, then retrieves the selected installer and verifies its exact size and SHA-512 against parsed update metadata before retaining it. The inspected source does not establish the complete trust behavior of the subsequent HTTP path.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; release-specific behavior and external TLS/framework enforcement were not independently audited.
The external HTTP trust implementation and the authority of the metadata endpoint were not independently audited.
